mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.account_no, a.user_id, u.username, u.real_name, a.account_type, a.balance, a.status, a.currency, a.open_date, a.create_time FROM account a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.user_id = u.id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE a.account_no = #{accountNo} AND a.deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE account SET balance = balance - #{amount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND balance >= #{amount}
UPDATE account SET balance = balance + #{amount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1
